title: MiMo TTS Narration Segments
description: Batch input schema for MiMo-V2.5-TTS narration (lecture, novel, podcast, short-video, etc.).

filename.description: Output filename. Always use .wav; format=pcm16 means stream chunk format, and the script writes those chunks into a WAV container.

voice.description: Preset voice for mimo-v2.5-tts, or data URI for voiceclone. Omit for voicedesign.

voice_sample_path.description: Optional local .mp3/.wav voice sample path for voiceclone; script converts it to data URL.

voice_design_prompt.description: 1-4 sentence voice identity prompt for mimo-v2.5-tts-voicedesign.

format.description: API audio format. Use wav for normal batch synthesis; use pcm16 only with stream=true. Output file is still .wav.

stream.description: If true, use stream=true and format=pcm16; script writes a WAV container from PCM16 chunks.

style_instruction.description: Natural-language delivery instruction placed in user.content.

speech_prefix_tags.description: Optional audio/style tags inserted at the beginning of assistant.content, e.g. ['温柔','平静'].

speech_text.description: Exact text to synthesize, placed in assistant.content.

audio.description: Optional raw audio object override for advanced users.

optimize_text_preview.description: Convenience field for voicedesign; copied into audio.optimize_text_preview when absent.
